comparison.objective: Move three fruits from a shared bin while another arm removes utensils; candidate calibrates and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires collision-aware pick-and-place around an independently moving coworker, not precision tool engagement or mechanical counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Scores fruit placement and invalidates arm contact or utensil loss; candidate scores stop angle, hardware retention, repeated cycles, drift, and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: The record tests dynamic shared-workspace avoidance during transport, not adjustment and lock retention.
